## Classifiability strata

Measured, not assumed. The W1 pilot's original premise — that malformed titles mark the
hard arcs — was **refuted**: 83 % of uninformative-title arcs carry an explicit `## Verdict`
block against 19 % of the rest, so the title heuristic *anti*-correlates with difficulty.

| stratum | meaning | count | share |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | explicit `## Verdict` block — directly extractable | 183 | 25.0 % |
| **B** | no block, but the title carries the verdict | 537 | 73.5 % |
| **C** | neither — genuinely hard, needs a full read | 11 | 1.5 % |
